## Testing

How did you test it? Tests added, and anything tried on real hardware (model, firmware).

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for the new code; `pytest` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` is clean
- [ ] User-facing strings in `strings.json` and all eight `translations/`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] README kept brief (a line or two per feature)
- [ ] No secrets (keys, tokens, passwords, diagnostics with private data)
